scope: Post-hoc assistant review of all stock-correct short cases lost by each large 75%-retained arm. Not blinded and not a replacement primary metric. Categories describe the inspected answer; no aggregate semantic-accuracy claim.
notes: Qwen multi-edit preserves the relative order of apples and tea but inserts cheese between them. The scorer expects appending cheese, although the prompt only says add cheese and keep remaining order; do not count this as an unambiguous content error. It also adds JSON fences.
Some strict failures are benign punctuation/capitalization, or correct content with extra explanatory text. Raw check counts must not be called general accuracy.
Word-limit-only checks can pass semantically empty or repetitive answers; Qwen27 half-size passes dog and hash-table despite broken content.
